story.title: The Puddle Parade
story.synopsis: A rainy morning turns the grove into puddles. Pip builds tiny boats so the ants can cross the stream.
story.storyText: Rain has filled the grove with puddles and the ant family cannot reach the berry bushes. Pip wants to help and designs leaf boats. The first boat sinks, but Pip tries again with Luma lighting the way, and soon a parade of boats carries everyone across.
story.moral: Trying again is part of inventing.

scenes.title: Rainy morning
scenes.summary: Rain falls on the grove and the ants are stuck behind a big puddle.

narration.text: As the sun slipped behind the willow, Pip reached for the little brass lantern.

shots.title: Puddles everywhere
shots.action: rain drips from willow leaves into wide puddles

shots.title: Pip has an idea
shots.action: Pip in a raincoat holds up a big leaf, eyes bright with an idea

dialogue.text: Leaf boats! We can build leaf boats!

scenes.title: The parade
scenes.summary: After one boat sinks, Pip tries again and a parade of leaf boats crosses the stream.

shots.title: Boats across the stream
shots.action: a line of leaf boats carrying ants floats across the stream while Luma lights the way

narration.text: One by one, the little boats sailed across, and the ants cheered.
